semantic_verdict: JUSTIFIED, AND ON A BETTER EVIDENCE BASE THAN ANY OTHER CANDIDATE IN THIS CLOSURE, WITH TWO SHARP LIMITS. What is established: JAG1 knockdown significantly reduces adhesive capacity to trophoblast spheroids in PRIMARY human endometrial epithelial cells (n=5) as well as Ishikawa, both p<0.05; NOTCH3 NICD - PATHWAY ACTIVITY, not transcript abundance, which is what a node defined as a signalling state requires - falls significantly on JAG1 knockdown in Ishikawa (p<0.05); HEY1 falls (p<0.01) while HES1 does not; and the viability confound is BOUNDED rather than entangled, because xCELLigence shows adhesion impaired within 3-8 h while proliferation is unimpaired up to 60 h and falls only after 80 h. LIMIT ONE: NOTCH3 IS NOT SHOWN TO BE THE NECESSARY RECEPTOR. No NOTCH3 knockdown, blockade or gamma-secretase arm exists; attribution rests on the direction of NICD change; and NOTCH1 AND NOTCH2 NICD were significantly INCREASED by JAG1 knockdown. The authors themselves write only that JAG1-NOTCH3 'may play a dominant role'. LIMIT TWO: TWO OF THE NODE'S THREE NAMED MEASURABLES ARE CARCINOMA-LINE-ONLY. Figure 2's own legend confines HEY1, HES1, all seven receptivity markers, PGR, ESR1 and the entire MAML1 arm to ISHIKAWA, and the primary-cell NOTCH3 NICD replication is a NON-SIGNIFICANT TREND at P=0.073, n=3 (Figure 3B legend), although the Results text and Abstract call it 'confirmed' - the legend governs and the discrepancy is recorded so a later unit does not inherit the abstract's wording. WHAT THE NODE MAY DEFENSIBLY MEAN, NARROWED TO THE EVIDENCE: the epithelial state in which JAG1 is present and JAG1-dependent NOTCH3 NICD is being produced, functionally coupled to trophoblast-spheroid adhesive capacity. It may NOT mean NOTCH3 is necessary for that adhesion, and it may NOT be used to explain the four Notch-INDEPENDENT markers (LIFR, ITGB3, MAOA, IGFBP1), which survive MAML1 knockdown.

semantic_verdict: DEFENSIBLE. Nuclear accumulation of ACTIVE beta-catenin is an activity state, not an abundance proxy, and WNT4 is shown to be a NECESSARY MEDIATOR rather than a correlate: recombinant BMP2 fails to promote differentiation in WNT4-silenced cells. Liao 2024 independently shows WNT4 falls on SMAD1/5 knockdown. B2 SWEEP, RECORDED BECAUSE IT IS THE MARGINAL CASE: this node survives the activity-versus-abundance test where S_FOXO1 and E_SOX17 do not, but not comfortably. Its activity half IS measured directly -- nuclear active beta-catenin under WNT4 manipulation, with DKK1 as the reciprocal control -- and its determinant reaches that half through WNT4, whose necessity is established functionally by siRNA rather than by expression alone. What is NOT measured in one step is BMP2 -> nuclear beta-catenin; the chain is BMP2 -> WNT4 transcript -> nuclear beta-catenin, and only the second step is on the activity variable. Recorded so that a future promotion does not treat this as settled.

Li 2013 tests only BMP2 as an input to WNT4, so the pass-through encoding is FAITHFUL to what was measured and inert for that reason - a formalism consequence, not a modelling error. THE LARGEST STRUCTURAL GAIN IN THIS UNIT IS AVAILABLE HERE AND IS REFUSED: IN_XAV939 is a declared v0.4 input that NO RULE READS, so wiring it to the stromal WNT arm costs no new free variable and gains 35 -> 37 with the FOXO1 conjunct. Do not connect XAV939 directly to S_WNT4_CTNNB1 by default' - and no compartment-specific exposure evidence exists. This is the third instance in v0.5 (after U3's E_HBEGF and U4's ANXA2 arm) of the largest available structural gain being refused on evidence.

semantic_verdict: JUSTIFIED IN A DISEASE FRAME, AND ONLY THERE. The node is defined as PATHOLOGICALLY EXCESSIVE stromal AKT activity, and Kang 2022 observes exactly that state: higher stromal p-AKT1 (Ser473) with total AKT1 unchanged in the eutopic endometrium of women with endometriosis, by semi-quantitative immunostaining, and CAPN7 gain of function raises p-AKT1 (Ser473) in primary HESC. Ser473 is an activation-site phosphorylation, so this is an activity-state readout and not an abundance proxy, and the definition is established rather than refuted. SYSTEM-LIMITED because the excess is observed only against endometriosis, in one study, by immunostaining scores, and the mechanistic arm uses normal-donor cells overexpressing CAPN7. AKT NECESSITY FOR FOXO1 EXCLUSION IS NOT TESTED (no AKT inhibitor or knockdown) - a limit on any future S_AKT_EXCESS -| S_FOXO1 EDGE, which is a separate edge-promotion decision, not on this node verdict.
